title: Made-to-Order Production Stage: The Date the Count Runs From (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
**Rule.** The production stage of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order pair is counted from one of three dates:

1. **The specifications confirmation date**, for a personalised pair whose specifications were confirmed 10 days or more before its production started. Its leather is cut and embossed at confirmation.
2. **The reservation date**, for a pair whose specifications were confirmed on the reservation date, provided its production started fewer than 10 days after that confirmation. Such a pair is built on a stock pattern whose leather is cut on the day it is ordered.
3. **The production start date**, for every other pair.

The first description that fits the pair decides. A *personalised* pair is one whose reservation records a personalisation. The 10 days are calendar days from the specifications confirmation date to the production start date.

**Decision table**

| Personalisation recorded | Specifications confirmed on the reservation date | Days from confirmation to production start | Count runs from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | 10 or more | Specifications confirmation date |
| Yes | Yes | Fewer than 10 | Reservation date |
| Yes | No | Fewer than 10 | Production start date |
| No | Yes | Fewer than 10 | Reservation date |
| No | Yes | 10 or more | Production start date |
| No | No | Any | Production start date |

**Illustrations (hypothetical pairs)**

- Personalised. Reserved 1 April, specifications confirmed 3 April, production started 15 April, which is 12 days after confirmation. The count runs from 3 April.
- Not personalised. Reserved and confirmed on 1 April, production started 6 April, 5 days after confirmation. The count runs from 1 April.
- Not personalised. Reserved and confirmed on 1 April, production started 11 April, 10 days after confirmation. The count runs from 11 April.
- Personalised. Reserved 1 April, confirmed 4 April, production started 9 April, 5 days after confirmation and not on the reservation date. The count runs from 9 April.
